full_prompt_en: A square experimental black and white photograph shows a close-up face and hand beneath the broad shadow of a hat, with translucent rectangular exposures layered across the image. A pale gray field fills the outer frame. The hat's curved brim runs from the far left across the top, forming a broad dark arc over the forehead. The head is tilted slightly back, so the nose points upward and the mouth sits near the center. One hand rises from the lower middle and rests at the chin, its fingers rendered with softer light than the face. The eyes are partly obscured by the brim and by overlapping tonal blocks, and one side of the face sinks into deep black. A darker square sits just inside the outer frame, while a smaller, lighter rectangle overlays the face from around the upper center to the lower right. These straight boundaries interrupt the organic contours, causing the cheek, eye, and hat to appear at slightly different tonal strengths in adjoining areas. The outer margins remain pale and relatively open, making the nested shapes conspicuous without added text or ornament. Fine grain and a little haze soften transitions inside the bright portions, while black patches retain a velvety density. Light falls from the upper right, illuminating the nose, one cheek, and the upper fingers, then fading through layered shadow beneath the brim. The image does not resolve into a conventional evenly lit head study; its superimposed exposures deliberately shift the visual reading from one plane to another. The overall composition is intimate and enigmatic, balancing a curved dark silhouette against blunt rectangular divisions and fragile pale detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验性黑白摄影呈现宽帽阴影下的面部与手，半透明的矩形曝光层叠在图像之上。外层画面是浅灰色。帽子的弯曲宽檐从最左侧横过上方，在额头上形成宽阔深色弧线。头略向后仰，因此鼻子朝上，嘴位于中央附近。一只手从下方中部升起，停在下巴处，手指的光比面部更柔和。眼睛被帽檐和重叠的明暗块面部分遮住，脸的一侧沉入浓黑。一个较暗的方块位于外框内侧，另一个更小、更亮的矩形从上方中央附近覆盖面部，延伸至右下。这些笔直边界打断有机轮廓，使面颊、眼部和帽子在相邻区域显出略有差别的明暗强度。外缘保持浅色且相对开阔，让套叠形状清楚可见，而无须加入文字或装饰。细颗粒和一点雾感柔化亮处的过渡，黑色斑块则保留绒面般的浓度。光从右上方落下，照亮鼻部、一侧面颊和手指上方，再透过帽檐下层叠的阴影逐渐消退。画面并非一幅常规、照明均匀的头部习作；叠加曝光有意让视觉阅读在不同平面间移动。整体构图亲密而神秘，以弯曲的深色剪影平衡生硬的矩形分割和脆弱的浅色细节。
style_prompt_en: Experimental monochrome photography layers translucent tonal fields with crisp rectangular boundaries over softer underlying forms. Velvety blacks, smoky middle grays, and pale silver highlights repeat at different strengths, so adjacent areas can present the same contour with changed exposure. Large curved dark shapes move behind rigid straight divisions, creating tension between organic flow and geometric cropping. Grain and slight optical haze blur some internal transitions, while the edges of the imposed blocks remain unusually clear. Directional light picks out isolated high value details and allows nearby planes to fall quickly into shadow. The frame retains broad quiet margins around a dense central overlap, giving the layered region visual pressure without extra decoration. Depth is ambiguous yet controlled because each tonal layer remains legible. The overall effect is tactile, graphic, and enigmatic, as photographic light and constructed framing compete across one compact field.
style_prompt_zh: 实验性黑白摄影把半透明的明暗层与边界清楚的矩形分区叠在更柔和的底层形体之上。绒黑、烟灰和浅银高光以不同强度重复，使同一轮廓在相邻区域呈现变化的曝光。宽阔弯曲的深色形状从笔直分割之后移动，在有机走势与几何裁切之间形成张力。颗粒和轻微光学雾感模糊内部某些过渡，覆盖色块的边缘却格外清楚。定向光挑出孤立的高明度细节，让邻近表面迅速落入阴影。画框在密集的中央叠层周围保留宽阔安静的边距，无需额外装饰便为重叠区带来视觉压力。纵深模糊却受控制，因为每个明暗层仍可辨认。整体效果有触感、图形化而神秘，摄影光线与刻意构造的框架在紧凑画面中互相角力。
theme_en: Experimental monochrome portrait with layered rectangular exposures
theme_zh: 叠加矩形曝光的实验性黑白肖像
name: Jack Davison
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
